notes.title: Tyr: Chains of Valhalla – Japan and Chinese release Is Ready! [Patch 1.05]
notes.content:
Heeeeeeellooooooooooo Nordics Vikings!! 
A new Patch is arriving and it comes with some exciting new news as well.
Thanks for all feedback, we listen you and continue working to make this game better.
And also, to celebrate our release on China and Japan, we are including new localization improvements for this steam version!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
• Now better Japanese Localization
• Include Chinese Localization
• Reduce texture size to optimizes and maintain a good frame rate.
• Now we include levels difficulty (easy, normal, hard) 
• Veorfolnir (boss) attack Balances 
• Fenrir (boss) attacks balances
• Nidhogg (boss) attack Balances 


[b]VISUALS[/b]
• Logi (boss) Tyr is not affected by environmental light on this stage
• Veorfolnir (Stage) stage visual changes.
• Garm (boss) stage visual changes.
• Ymir (boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.
• Nidhogg(boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.
• Logi (boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.
• Veorfolnir (boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.
• Fenrir (boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.
• Garm (boss) Modified visual feedback to show life progression.

[b]FIXES[/b]
• Fixed camera movements
• Now Tyr fall more faster
• Added some collider areas


Thank Again you all for your patience and support!

notes.title: Tyr: Chains of Valhalla - Patch 1.04 Is Ready !
notes.content:
Thanks to all your support and feedback we are making a better experience, more fun, challenging and more exciting. 

We are delivering visual improvements in boss fights so now you'll get more feedback on damage progression during the battle, we also balanced the game in many other levels and we have a huge surprise in the final boss battle that will let you with your mouth wide open!

This is definitely the time to get back into Tyr: Chains of Valhalla!.
Please keep the feedback coming on our Steam Forum Page. We will continue making Tyr: Chains of Valhalla the best game that we can possible offer to you

IMPROVEMENTS
•	Enemies balancing and reorder.
•	New checkpoints.
•	Now the checkpoints restore your life.
•	Veorfolnir (boss) New environmental mechanic
•	Fenrir (boss) New Attacks. It creates a copy of itself
•	Fenrir (boss) Attacks Balance. attacks are unlocked on every life phase.
•	Garm (boss) removed electric field attack and change with an environmental hazard.
•	Garm (boss) Increased 100 HP.
•	Garm (boss) Increased the time that player can damage it.
•	Added tips on each boss level.
•	Increased player bullets collider.

VISUALS
•	Ymir (boss)  Added visual feedback to show life progression.
•	Nidhogg(boss) Added visual feedback to show life progression.
•	Logi (boss) Added visual feedback to show life progression.
•	Veorfolnir (boss) Added visual feedback to show life progression.
•	Fenrir (boss) Added visual feedback to show life progression.
•	Garm (boss) Added visual feedback to show life progression.

FIXES
•	Fixed problem with screen size option.
•	Power Ups are removed when player die.
•	Cullet color not affected by environment post processing effects.
•	Anti-aliasing applied to cameras.
•	Fixed bug in collectibles screen.



Video Guide
Posting our latest Video Update here too: https://youtu.be/XMCeX5Pu4VQ

notes.title: Tyr: Chains of Valhalla - Patch 1.03 Now Available for download!
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.03[/b] is here and it comes with some exciting new features as well! On top of having more than 50 bug fixes and improvements, the player can show its best time with our new leaderboards system. If there was any time to get back into [b]Tyr: Chains of Valhalla[/b], this is definitely the time! Please keep the feedback coming on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/609720/discussions/]Steam Forums Page[/url]. We will continue to make Tyr: Chains of Valhalla the best experience that we possibly can. Thank you all for your patience and support.

[b]Patch 1.03 Notes[/b] 


[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]:
[list]
[*]New and more detailed tutorial level.

[*]Show green text color when you get a better time in the "Select stage screen".

[*]Show red text color when you get a worst time in the "Select stage screen".

[*]New "Settings menu" on in-game pause menu.

[*]New bar to show dash cooldown.

[*]Progress bar added in-game levels and updated each checkpoint.

[*]Progression porcentage on "Select stage screen".

[*]Remaining time indicator on "Loading screens".

[*]Pause game when the controller is disconnected.

[*]Now you can make a rapid shooting while smash the shoot button or hold you autoshoot.
[/list]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]:
[list]
[*]Switch weapon at any time.

[*]Switch element at any time.

[*]Energy core's tab animation when receive a new energy core.

[*]More delay in dialog texts when receive a new energy core.

[*]Enemies' shots cooldown added when the player is detected.

[*]Checkpoints, health packs and power-ups relocated in-game.

[*]Sensitive dash and jump control.

[*]New walljump, now needs to move your stick to the wall and jump.

[*]Confirmation message added when select "Restart level" on in-game pause menu.

[*]Confirmation message added when select "Main screen" on in-game pause menu.

[*]Confirmation message added when select "Select stage" on in-game pause menu.

[*]Enemies can not shoot you if they're out of the camera.

[*]Tyr's bullets can not continue out of the camera.

[*]Enemies' bullets lifetime reduced from 2 sec to 1.5 sec.

[*]Tyr's bullets lifetime reduced from 2 sec to 1.5 sec.

[*]Ymir (boss) attack animation speed change from 1 to 2 sec when he hits the floor.

[*]Ymir (boss) shield attack animation speed change fron 1 to 1.5 sec.

[*]Garm (boss) always shows and hide out after he attacks 5 times.

[*]Niddhog (boss) color arrangement.

[*]You can attack Veolfornir (boss) when he's on the left or right sides.

[*]Levels and enemies balancing and reorder.

[*]Unlock "Continue options" after complete the tutorial level.
[/list]


[b]VISUALS[/b]:
[list]
[*]New VFX on HUD when a power-up is dropped.

[*]Enemies' health bar change color to white when received a critical shot.

[*]"Critical damage" spark on bosses when shoot them with the right element.

[*]Blinking on bosses damage when received a non-critical shot.

[*]Tyr's single shot particle re-design.

[*]Fire viking's shot particle re-design.

[*]Plasma viking's shot particle re-design.

[*]Ice viking's shot particle re-design.

[*]Plasma grunt soldier's shot particle re-design.

[*]Fire grunt soldier's shot particle re-design.

[*]Ice grunt soldier's shot particle re-design.

[*]Plasma dragon turret's shot particle re-design.

[*]Fire dragon turret's shot particle re-design.

[*]Tyr blinks after shoot him.
[/list]


[b]FIXES[/b]:
[list]
[*]Enemies' explosion animation.

[*]Vertical platforms colliders.

[*]Irregular dash jump in vertical axis.

[*]Grenades colliders after explosion, now it reduces gradually.

[*]Camera boundaries colliders.

[*]Logi (boss) attack speed (head only).

[*]Franky's attack stops with pause.
[/list]


[b]PC EXCLUSIVES[/b]:
[list]
[*]HUD control display changes depending of the connected controller.

[*]Leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Update 1.00.BVcv
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for participating in the closed beta, with the comments we received we have improved the game in the release version, we hope that these changes make the game more enjoyable.

Some of the changes are:
- The enemies are more dynamic, so the game has become a bit more difficult, just a bit ;)
- Dynamic boss music, so now you have an idea of how much remaining HP the boss has.
- Steam input configuration (PS4 and generic gamepads, optional for XInput native gamepads)
- Many cosmetic fixes

Also, we have included two new functions only for the Steam version:

- Leaderboards in the Steam community! Now you can compete to become the best Asgard legend.
- Huginn and Muninn can read the messages of your friends in the game! Your friends can say hello while you play without having to interrupt your game.
